correctness.rationale: The Ewens probability of a specified three-arrow partial injection equals θ^{number of forced closed cycles}/[(θ+n−1)(θ+n−2)(θ+n−3)], by contracting open paths and removing closed forced cycles. Exhausting three-arrow loop/two-cycle/three-cycle configurations gives the six cubic numerator polynomials and normalization. Subtraction leaves only four mixed patterns with vector (0,−1,1,1,−1,0), yielding the exact TV expression. On θ<1 the magnitude strictly decreases; above θ=1 the derivative sign quartic has a unique positive zero by its coefficient signs. The explicit witness θ=n dominates θ↓0 for every n≥5 since the difference polynomial becomes m⁴+15m³+72m²+116m+18>0, m=n−5. Scaling yields θ_n/n→2 and TV→8/27. I independently enumerated full permutations n=4..7, computed exact cycle weights for θ=1/2,2 and checked every site pair against the TV formula; all cases passed.
residual_risks: Partial-injection computations alone are finite checks; all-n theorem rests on path contraction and symbolic coefficient enumeration.

value.rationale: Conjugation-invariant Ewens law is not invariant under relabeling one-line source positions. Exact six-pattern local order laws and a rank-one difference mode quantify this natural lack of exchangeability. The sharp size-four exception, unique finite bias parameter for every n≥5 and nonvanishing 8/27 macroscopic TV limit are intrinsic, nonroutine probabilistic invariants useful to local permutation-pattern work.
residual_risks: Does not imply longer-window joint laws or arbitrary conjugation-invariant measures.
